## Description

Buys after positive standardized earnings surprises and sells or shorts after negative surprises as prices potentially continue adjusting after the announcement.

## Where it may fit

Following material earnings surprises, especially where analyst revisions and trading frictions slow price discovery.

## Vehicles

Equity event-driven, long-short quant and factor funds.

## Required data

Timestamped earnings actuals and analyst consensus, announcement timestamp, surprise measure, guidance, prices and trading halts.

## Caveats

Overlap with SUE/momentum signals should be measured; execution immediately after announcements can be costly and drift evidence is sample-dependent.
